column3: Launch Visual Studio; create a C# Console App via the All-languages filter; capture the default selected target framework; create the project; validate the project Properties Output type is 'Console Application' and the target framework matches the captured value; open Program.cs and paste in a counting 'Hello world' console app; run it with Ctrl+F5; edit PrintSomething (more '!' then a faster _rev increment) live in the editor; click 'Apply Code Changes' (Hot Reload) and verify the running console output picks up both edits without a restart; then clean up and close everything. NOTE: the language-filter combo, template picker, Properties fields, editor Go-To-Line/clipboard edits, the Hot Reload 'Apply Code Changes' button, and the Debug Console window are all Visual Studio version / UI-language dependent and flagged LIVE-TUNE in the Expected column.
